en.headline: Observatory records 17.8 degrees, lowest of the autumn so far
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said the temperature at its headquarters fell to 17.8 degrees at 5.30am on Tuesday, with the Strong Monsoon Signal and Red Fire Danger Warning still in force.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory recorded a temperature of 17.8 degrees Celsius at its headquarters at 5.30am on Tuesday, the lowest reading so far this autumn.

The Strong Monsoon Signal, issued at 6.10am on Monday, remains in force, with strong northerly winds continuing. The Red Fire Danger Warning, also issued on Monday morning, is still active. The Observatory said the fire risk remains extreme and the public should take extra precautions.

Regional readings around 7am showed urban areas mostly between 16 and 18 degrees, with some New Territories locations a degree or two lower. The Observatory expects the day to stay sunny and dry, with a maximum around 23 degrees and humidity as low as 35 to 40 per cent in places.
Temperatures are forecast to rise gradually later in the week as the monsoon eases, with more cloud and a few showers possible by the weekend.

zh.headline: 天文台清晨錄得十七點八度 入秋以來最低
zh.dek: 天文台表示周二清晨五時半總部氣溫降至十七點八度，強烈季候風信號及紅色火災危險警告仍然生效。
body: 香港天文台週二清晨五時半在總部錄得十七點八攝氏度，是今年入秋以來的最低氣溫。
周一清晨六時十分發出的強烈季候風信號仍然生效，偏北強風持續。同時發出的紅色火災危險警告亦維持，天文台表示火災危險極高，市民須特別留意。
約上午七時的分區資料顯示，市區大多介乎十六至十八度，新界部分地區再低一兩度。天文台預計今天天晴乾燥，最高氣溫約二十三度，部分地區相對濕度可低至百分之三十五至四十。
隨著季候風於本週後期緩和，氣溫將逐步回升；週末雲量增多，並有幾陣馱雨。
